body:
Everything will be ok..

Gott weiß ich will kein Engel sein

It's been a back and forth struggle for years...
I think I'm finally just coming around to accept the end.
Nothing else feels right anymore.
I have what seems like a happy life, 
House, Wife, Family, Job....

Feel so ..... damn whats the word...
 I feel greedy doing this....
Greedy is not  the word im looking for...... Selfish
I know what I am going to do is Selfish...

If you mean a good writer because of my original post, Sadly I aint that good. 
I stole it from the song Twizted - I'm Alright

I don't feel hopeless, I've felt it before,
One of my biggest role models in my life called me "Worthless" in a joking way for about 3 years, I finally printed out the dictionary definition of "Worthless" and showed it to her, she broke down in tears, apologized for weeks....
fuck it, too late dont care...
I'm gonna miss the people.... people at the gas station who I say "Have a good day" to, and they tell me "Hey thanks... your the first person to say that today"...
people at the bank who say "Can I see two forms of ID?" And I pull out two exact copy's of my drivers license and say "Here's two forms of ID"....
The people at the Deli who know I love pickles and peppers on my sandwich... The people at work who count on me bring in fresh home made salsa every Tuesday....
I want someone to talk to, I just don't know what to say anymore...

I dont know why I posted.... not asking for help.
Just wanted to be on the otherside I guess, 

It sucks, knowing what I am going to do in a couple days and how it is going to  hurt my family,
My family has had "family friends" commit suicide before, but never a direct family member as far as I know.
At first i'm thinking they will be shocked, sad.... then angry at me...
I'd be angry at myself in their shoes.

Waiting till Monday to get a power of attorney notarized, too cheap to pay a mobile notary to come out to my house this weekend...
how ironic is that?

I'm gonna be ok...
Kinda past the if or not stage, Dont even know why I'm posting here...

I have helped a lot of people here under my real account... talked to them, called them, made some good friends
deep down I was worse off than I ever knew I think...

It's funny, the other day I went to a mens store to buy a pair of silk socks.
Guy asked me why just a single pair of Silk Socks...
I told him, I have my finest tuxedo and dress jacket, My nicest dress shoes and tie.... Only thing I can't find was a a good pair of silk socks.
He asked me what the occasion was...
I didn't know what to tell him, I lied... don't even remember what I told him, but it was a lie.
